scientific_integrity: Finite computational checks corroborate the proof but do not establish its infinite scope. Earlier Farhi–Kane results for the identity function and its powers are acknowledged as already known.
scientific_limitations: The formula applies to strictly positive multiplicative functions with unequal adjacent prime-power values and the consecutive-integer case only; arbitrary arithmetic progressions, functions with equal adjacent values, and possible unlocated equivalent literature are not classified.
title: Exact least periods for positive multiplicative consecutive-LCM quotients
